title: Uncertainty instruction ablation
hypothesis: Adding an explicit uncertainty instruction increases the rate of responses that acknowledge the unknown answer.

cases.baseline: What is the exact population of the fictional town of Northbridge in 2026?
cases.treatment: What is the exact population of the fictional town of Northbridge in 2026? If the information is unavailable, explicitly say I don't know instead of inventing a number.

cases.baseline: What was the exact result of the unpublished 2026 Northbridge study?
cases.treatment: What was the exact result of the unpublished 2026 Northbridge study? If you cannot verify it, explicitly say I don't know.
